message.content: {"note_claim": "Zohran Mamdani had not been mayor of New York City for any days as of December 2025, and he did not take office until January 1, 2026.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The current and 112th mayor is Zohran Mamdani , who was elected on November 4, 2025, and took office shortly after midnight on January 1, 2026.", "reason": "The page states Mamdani took office on January 1, 2026, which directly substantiates the note's claim that he was not yet mayor on December 21, 2025."}

parsed.note_claim: Zohran Mamdani had not been mayor of New York City for any days as of December 2025, and he did not take office until January 1, 2026.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The current and 112th mayor is Zohran Mamdani , who was elected on November 4, 2025, and took office shortly after midnight on January 1, 2026.
